name: 60543 · Oswego, IL
findings: ZIP 60543 (Oswego) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60543 (Oswego) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60543 (Oswego) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
